title: SuperX: Make Every Post Move (animated posts)
summary: A 15 s sibling of 18-superx-oneshot, selling SuperX's animated posts. Same dark warm-charcoal and ember-red system, but framed as a motion demo with a camera HUD (REC, timecode, '60 FPS / 128 BPM', chapter labels 01 3D CAMERA, 02 SPRING PHYSICS, 03 SHAPE MORPH, 04 KINETIC TYPE). Beats: 'Make it move.' with outline-to-fill reveal, red neon rectangle tunnel cycling TIMING / WEIGHT / feel, a post card liked with spark burst then fanning into a 3D arc, a glowing growth curve, a grid of tiles that each demo a type effect (SCALE, SLIDE, SPIN, STRETCH, DROP, BLUR, SPLIT), stats, logo and red CTA.
fit_reason: Same premium dark-red system as 18, but more about motion craft than product value; the kinetic-type tile grid and HUD labels are reusable, the neon tunnel is louder than SaaSSuite needs.

palette.mood: dark premium, warm charcoal with red neon glow, embers and grain

typography.display: heavy neo-grotesk (Inter Display Black) + condensed serif italic for 'move.' / 'feel' / 'creators'
typography.case: mixed (upper for TIMING/WEIGHT and tile labels, sentence for lines)
typography.size_behaviour: huge centred words; medium tile labels; tiny mono HUD
typography.notes: Serif italic word always red or set inside a red ring. Stats: bold numerals + red '+' + italic serif label ('11,294+ creators').

text_animation: outline text fills in solid, one word punches in oversized with blur then snaps to size
italic word stamps multiple ghost copies (echo trail)
word swap through depth (TIMING → WEIGHT → DEPTH) with z-blur
per-tile type effects: scale, slide, spin, stretch, drop (letters fall in), blur, split, barcode glitch
motion: fly-through of concentric neon rectangles (3D camera)
spring physics: like button burst with radial sparks
cards fan out along a 3D arc
glowing comet traces a curve with node dots
tiles flip in 3D one by one
graphic_elements: camera HUD (REC dot, timecode, 60 FPS / 128 BPM, corner brackets, chapter number + label)
3D dark tiles with red active state
ui_treatment: Rebuilt dark post cards (avatar, text, metrics) used as props for physics demos.

sound.music: punchy electronic at 128 BPM (labelled on screen)
sound.sfx: whooshes, pops on like, ticks, impacts

signature_moves: chapter HUD naming the technique (01 3D CAMERA, 02 SPRING PHYSICS...)
bold sans + red serif-italic accent word
kinetic-type tile grid where each tile demos its own verb
red neon rectangle tunnel with word swaps

best_segments.what: 'Make it move.' outline → punch-in fill with chromatic split and red italic echo
Like-burst spring physics on post card, cards fan into 3D arc, comet curve
Kinetic-type tile grid (each verb animates itself) then stat counters

recreate.how: Remotion/GSAP: SplitText per-letter effects per tile, CSS 3D for tunnel and arc, canvas sparks, HUD overlay component, beat grid at 128 BPM.
recreate.prompt: Dark ember-red motion demo with a camera HUD showing chapter labels: 'Make it move.' with a red italic serif word, a neon rectangle tunnel cycling single words, a post card liked with spark burst, and a grid of tiles each animating its own verb (scale, slide, spin, drop, blur, split).
